about.heading: About Stark
paragraphs: Stark is a Saudi manufacturer of integrated environments — woodworks, furniture, and mattresses — delivered from raw material to finished interior under one partner.

We are more than a manufacturer: a trusted solutions partner that brings design, manufacturing, and on-site execution into a single, accountable process. Every piece is engineered for durability and finished to a standard that hospitality demands.
From bespoke wood elements and full interior fit-outs to comfort-engineered mattresses, our work is built to last and made to measure — with fair, quality-first practices at every stage.

Sculptural wood piece in a light-filled space.

hero.body: Element brings extraordinary, natural wood flooring, distinctive furniture and unique, wooden features . We features wood products and handcrafted home accessories and gift. Each piece of wood has its own story that started long before it got to us.

items.title: Furniture
items.body: No matter what your personal style, we have just the right furniture for your living environment. Element brings extraordinary, natural wood flooring, distinctive furniture and unique, wooden features. Furniture collections that blend classic style with heirloom quality.

items.title: Features
items.body: Wooden walls can add spiritual simplicity to that space behind the bed, the one we see every night right before we go to sleep, warm the living room or separate two different areas in the dining room.  Natural wood connect the interiors to the peace-giving outdoors.

items.title: Flooring
items.body: Solid hardwood adds character, warmth and value to any room in your house.  We offer exceptional wood floors that will help you enhance the look of your home. You can get wood floors that look shiny and new, or you can buy brand new wood that looks like an antique.

steps.title: Sourced
steps.body: Reclaimed and responsibly felled timber, hand-picked for grain and character.

steps.title: Milled
steps.body: Cut and slow-dried to reveal each board's live edge and natural figure.

steps.title: Crafted
steps.body: Joined by hand in our workshop, built to outlast trends and generations.

steps.title: Finished
steps.body: Hand-oiled to protect the wood and deepen its natural, living tone.

items.quote: They didn't sell me furniture — they handed me a piece of a forest, with a hundred years of story already living in the grain.
items.author: Mara H.  ·  Portland

items.quote: The grain runs like a river across our table. Ten years in, it still stops guests mid-sentence when they walk in.
items.author: Daniel O.  ·  Asheville

items.quote: Every knot and live edge was left exactly where the tree put it. That kind of honesty is the whole reason we chose Element.
items.author: Lena & Co.  ·  Boulder

items.title: Mattress
items.body: Built from carefully selected foams and fibers, our mattresses deliver lasting comfort and support at a fair price. Cooling layers help you sleep cooler than conventional foam, and the construction is made to keep its shape for years.

items.title: Pillow
items.body: A pillow should do more than feel soft — it should contour to your neck and hold its support through the night. Our pillows pair breathable fibers with a cover made for a cool, comfortable feel.

items.title: Comforter
items.body: Everyone prefers a different warmth. Our comforter is designed for both — a cooler side for warmer nights and a softer, warmer side for when you want to stay cozy.
